resources.string: Search sends the text you submit to your device’s geocoding service. Coverage varies by provider. No device location or journal history is sent.
Network geocoding is disabled. Enable it in Settings to search, or choose coordinates offline.
No matching places. Try a city, landmark, or full address.
Enter at least two characters and tap Search. Typing does not send a request.
Place search is unavailable. Check your connection or try again. You can still choose coordinates offline.
Place search timed out. Try again or choose coordinates offline.
